limitations: Synthetic assets only, not historical stocks or native model alpha.
ScaleEvidence is endogenous pooled funded exits, not verified independent trades.
Categories are simultaneous counterfactual constraints on target; evidence failure and evidence-implied concentration cap overlap.
A counted over positive-EV incumbents; B-F over native ADDs; per-group keys are seed/quality/variant/date/ticker.
F means prior ranked commitments reduce available cash; no claim alternate queue improves outcomes.
Future return used only for post-run case selection, never callbacks.
Corrected rerun restricted to strong quality; weak and misnull only audited, not retuned.
root_cause: 2% per-trade limit incorrectly reused as aggregate budget for scaling at manager reservation and kernel evidence gating; ordinary entry gate is per position.
double_counting_finding: No blanket literal doubling: manager other_equity_risk covers other existing positions; reserved_loss covers queue-funded increments, normally disjoint. It does reserve ordinary increments too. Kernel uses max(other_equity_risk,reserved_risk), not their sum. Both wrongly make other trades consume the per-trade allowance; stale close-time floors survive exits and kernel reservation precedes cash fills.
intended_constraint: For each admitted increase, total candidate post-trade weight * (max(stop_distance,gap_risk) + round_trip_cost) <= 0.02. Other holdings do not consume that trade budget. Optional aggregate guard must use a distinct explicitly configured limit and de-duplicated portfolio risk state.
corrected_comparison_scope: 12 seeds 1101-1112, calibrated strong tapes only, 10/15/20%, 36 corrected portfolios; 72 unchanged-policy audit replays for all 3 qualities at 15/20%. Test day executions counted separately; no search.

category_definitions.A: No native ADD on a positive-EV incumbent stock-date. Zero in scaling variants; denominator must include opportunities, because an ADD-only denominator cannot contain missing ADDs.
category_definitions.B: Full requested evidence tier not passed; exact failed fields stored. A 20% failure may still permit 15%. Independent_confirmation=False is NOT a failure under current 15/20 policy.
category_definitions.C: Full target violates either standalone candidate risk, other holdings plus candidate risk, or prior queued modeled losses. Subcategories mutually partition these tests in that order.
category_definitions.D: Requested concentration exceeds evidence-approved tier (10/15/20). Overlaps B; not an independent reason to remove evidence gates.
category_definitions.E: Initial settled cash cannot cover standalone-safe requested increment with execution costs. Split into settlement-only shortfall and insufficient cash even including receivables.
category_definitions.F: Prior ranked commitments reduce cash and leave less than standalone-safe requested increment. Overlaps E when both initial cash shortage and queue consumption apply; queue-risk subtype reported under C.
